annotations.title: Make a presentation without an account

description: Use this when the user wants a new presentation made from a prompt and has not connected a PitchBoost account, or has declined to connect one: a sales or investor pitch, a proposal, a report or update, a talk, or a lesson or class presentation, in any language. It needs no sign-in. It returns a share link at once: the deck is written in the background over a few minutes, and the link shows a progress page until it is ready. With a website, the deck is designed in the logo, colors and fonts read from it. If the deck is for a business and no website was given, the first call makes nothing and returns one question to put to the user (their company's website, which they can skip); call again with the answer. The deck carries a small PitchBoost badge, and the response includes a single-use claim token the user can enter after signing in to move the deck into their own account. Redesigning a deck the user already has needs a connected account and rebuild_deck.

prompt.description: What the presentation is about, who will see it, and what it should achieve. For a pitch, include the company, the offer and the audience. Up to 1000 characters.

skip_website.description: Set to true only when the user was asked for their website and chose to skip, or said they have none. The deck is then designed without a brand read from a website.

website.description: The website of the business or organization presenting the deck (the user's own), for example acme.com. PitchBoost reads its logo, colors and fonts so the deck is in that brand. Pass only an address the user gave. Never a customer's, a prospect's or a source's website, and never a guess.
